red_time2string.pro


Routines

top source red_time2string

result = red_time2string(time, days=days)

PURPOSE: This function converts a time length in seconds to a more readible string version of that number in years, days, minutes, and seconds CATEGORY: utilities CALLING SEQUENCE: result = red_time2string(time, [/days]) INPUTS: time: A time length in seconds KEYWORD PARAMETERS: days: If set, time is interpreted to be a length in days, not seconds. OUTPUTS: That time, converted to a more sensible string EXAMPLE: IDL> print, red_time2string(3605.5) 1 hour, 0 minutes and 5.5 seconds IDL> print, red_time2string(!dpi * 1D8) 9 years, 351 days, 2 hours, 27 minutes and 45.4 seconds IDL> print, red_time2string(1.5, /days) 1 day, 12 hours, 0 minutes and 0.0 seconds MODIFICATION HISTORY: April 5 2009: Written by Chris Beaumont April 7 2009: Added \days keyword December 15 2025: MGL. Add red_ namespace for inclusion in sstred.
